images.title: Business Profile fields to get right
images.alt: Checklist of Google Business Profile fields: real business name, specific primary category, direct phone, regular and holiday hours, details and real photos.
images.caption: Complete, accurate information is what lets Google match your profile to the right searches.

items: Real-world business name, with no keywords or city added
Specific primary category: "This business IS a"
Address or service area, set up correctly
Phone number that reaches the business directly
Regular hours, plus special hours for holidays
Attributes, services and a description written for customers
Real photos of the storefront, inside, team and finished work

images.title: Should your profile show an address?
images.alt: Decision chart: businesses serving customers at their address show it, those that travel hide it and list service areas, hybrids show both.
images.caption: P.O. boxes and virtual offices you don't actually work from aren't acceptable addresses either way.

branches.result: Show the address on your profile
Remove the address and list up to 20 service areas by city or postal code
Hybrid business: show the address along with a service area

images.after: What to fix on your own website
images.title: Website work that backs up the profile
images.alt: Four cards: a real location or service page, LocalBusiness structured data, page speed and basic SEO, and an optional embedded map.
images.caption: Your site confirms the same details as your profile. It plays a supporting role, not the main one.

items.title: Location or service page
items.text: Name, address or area, phone and hours in plain text, plus local answers

items.title: LocalBusiness markup
items.text: JSON-LD with at least name and address; test it with the Rich Results Test

items.title: The basics
items.text: Fast loading on a phone, no broken pages, no missing titles

items.title: Embedded map
items.text: Handy for visitors, but Google doesn't list it as a ranking help
